title: 第17章 摊牌了，不装了
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
从万卡阁提着满满一盒子卡牌回家。

    林奇刚走到奇妙物语商铺门口，就发现柜台后坐着的不是老爹林峰，而是他的好基友瑞廉。

    瑞廉正低着头，一边整理凝血膏的盒子，一边时不时叹气，全然没注意到门口的林奇。

    “瑞廉叔，你怎么在这看店？”

    瑞廉听到林奇的声音，猛地抬起头，像是看到了救星，快步从柜台后跑出来。

    “小奇啊，你可算回来了！你爹他…… 他疯了！”

    “疯了？”

    林奇愣了一下，连忙追问：“瑞廉叔，你慢慢说，我爹怎么了？”

    瑞廉深吸一口气，掰着手指头给林奇数林峰的异常举动。

    什么花了五十卡恩买了件非常华丽的衣服啊！说自己是什么制卡师，将各种石头、骨头的堆满房间，拿着把菜刀从那里砍。

    “小奇，那可是五十卡恩啊！我和你爹从小一起长大，他那三卡恩买的衣服穿了五年都舍不得扔，现在竟然花五十卡恩买衣服，他疯了，他一定是被雷德刺激到了。”

    “嗯？”

    前半段林奇还当个乐子听着，当听到雷德的名字，他脸色一变。

    “雷德？他又怎么了？”

    “呃…”

    见自己好像说漏了，瑞廉连忙打了个哈哈。

    “没事没事，我说顺嘴了。你别多想，雷德没找你爹麻烦，真的！”

    林奇眼神微眯，盯着瑞廉。

    但看对方那躲闪的眼神，他知道自己问什么也问不出来，也没有再刨根问底。

    林奇深吸一口气，压下心里的担忧，心里暗暗想道：“反正我已经觉醒了规则卡这个金手指，给我点时间，以后雷德再来挑事，直接打得他妈都不认识！”

    “叔，你放心吧，我爹没事。今天下午我们不营业了，去家里吃饭。”

    见林奇已经将休息中的牌子挂上了，瑞廉还是有些担忧。

    “真的没事吗？”

    两人一前一后走进家里的小院，刚推开房门，就听到“砰砰乓乓”的声音，像是有人在砸东西。

    二人对视一眼，连忙走进里屋。

    只见林峰正蹲在地上，面前摆着一堆兽骨、毛皮和五颜六色的石头，手里拿着一把菜刀，正小心翼翼地削着一根兽骨，嘴里还念念有词。

    “这骨头密度不够，得削得再薄点，不然做出来的卡牌品质不行……”

    “爹，你这是在做…做卡牌呀。”

    林奇本想说是在做工艺品的，可转念一想，瑞廉就在身边，这不正是帮老爹坐实“制卡师”身份的好机会吗？
content_en:
Carrying a box full of cards home from Wanka Pavilion.

As soon as Lin Qi walked to the door of the Wonderful Story store, he found that the person sitting behind the counter was not his father Lin Feng, but his good friend Rui Lian.

Rui Lian was lowering his head, sorting out the boxes of coagulation ointment, and sighing from time to time, completely unaware of Lin Qi at the door.

"Uncle Ruilian, why are you looking at the store here?"

When Ruilian heard Lynch's voice, he raised his head suddenly, as if he saw his savior, and quickly ran out from behind the counter.

"Xiao Qi, you're finally back! Your father... he's crazy!"

"Crazy?"

Lin Qi was stunned for a moment and quickly asked: "Uncle Ruilian, please tell me slowly, what happened to my father?"

Ruilian took a deep breath and counted Lin Feng's abnormal behavior with his fingers.

Why did I spend fifty kahns to buy a very gorgeous dress?He said that he was some kind of card maker, piled all kinds of stones and bones into the room, and took a kitchen knife to chop them from there.

"Xiao Qi, that's fifty kahns! Your father and I grew up together. He couldn't bear to throw away the clothes he bought for three kahns after wearing them for five years. Now he spends fifty kahns to buy clothes. He's crazy. He must have been stimulated by Red."

"Huh?"

Lynch was just listening to it for fun in the first half, but when he heard Red's name, his expression changed.

"Red? What happened to him?"

"Uh..."

Seeing that he seemed to have missed the point, Ruilian quickly laughed.

"It's okay, it's okay, I said it smoothly. Don't think too much, Red didn't trouble your father, really!"

Lin Qi narrowed his eyes slightly and stared at Ruilian.

But looking at the other party's evasive eyes, he knew that he couldn't ask anything, and he didn't inquire further.

Lynch took a deep breath, suppressed the worries in his heart, and thought to himself: "Anyway, I have awakened the golden finger of the rule card. Give me some time. If Red comes to stir up trouble in the future, he will beat him until he doesn't even recognize him!"

"Uncle, don't worry, my dad is fine. We are closed this afternoon. Let's go have dinner at home."

Seeing that Lin Qi had put up the resting sign, Ruilian was still a little worried.

"Is it really okay?"

The two walked into the small courtyard of their home one after another. As soon as they opened the door, they heard a "bang bang bang bang bang" sound, as if someone was smashing something.

The two looked at each other and quickly walked into the back room.

I saw Lin Feng squatting on the ground, with a pile of animal bones, furs and colorful stones in front of him. He was holding a kitchen knife in his hand and was carefully peeling an animal bone while mumbling something.

"The density of this bone is not enough. It needs to be cut thinner, otherwise the quality of the cards produced will not be good..."

"Dad, you are making...making cards."

Lin Qi wanted to say that he was making handicrafts, but then he thought about it. Ruilian was by his side. Isn't this a good opportunity to help his father establish his identity as a "card maker"?
